verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. Both keep the maroon overlay and the type hierarchy, but the overlay stops around y≈575. That leaves the bottom corner marks (slash and circle) floating over the photo, detached from the box they are supposed to frame. Inside the box there is also a large dead gap between the rule and 'Join WADE team'. In A the bottom marks sit even lower (y≈690), with the circle over a man's head. B's marks are slightly closer to the box, so the misalignment is a little less severe.
